description.narrative: The cooperation aims to build trust between people divided by the contact line through dialogue and discreet joint efforts to address shared challenges, complementing the Track 1 peace process. This is supported by policy ideas from the Black Sea dialogue group to enhance predictability in the maritime zone, joint preventive and environmental projects under the JEDI format to avert disasters near the frontline, and humanitarian solutions proposed by civil society, which are fed into peace talks or exchanged between conflict parties.

title.narrative: Options for improving the humanitarian situation on the ground, as articulated by civil society, have been channelled to peace talks or shuttled between the conflict parties.
Increased cooperation to address issues of common concern across the line of contact.

target.value: Several ideas from HD's cross-contact line dialogue tracks have been articulated and reflected in policy decisions or in the official negotiations.

actual.value: During the first weeks of the invasion, HD advised the highest levels of government on the working of humanitarian corridors and other ways to improve the humanitarian situation on the ground.

target.value: Cross-contact line dialogue tracks have become consolidated platforms that engage in joint (or parallel) activities to address issues of common concern, including advising decision-makers on how to address problems in the conflict zone. The peace process has become more inclusive, taking into account the voices of women and civil society, who now speak more cohesively. Joint ideas and cooperation across the line of contact lay the groundwork for a smoother reintegration process.

actual.value: Some dialogue held on a variety of matters, however, difficult due to circumstances to maintain cross-contact line dialogue.

title.narrative: Innovative ideas for dealing with the tensions in the Black Sea are conveyed to decision-making circles.
Briefing of decision makers and affiliated experts.

target.value: Concepts and ideas developed in the Black Sea have been presented to experts and or officials of concerned state institutions.

actual.value: HD continued to monitor the implementation of the Black Sea Grain Initiative. When it ended in July 2023, HD worked with local experts to come up with several creative ideas on how to build and expand on it, whilst taking into account the changed balance of power in the Black Sea. These included the opportunity to open up more ports and include more diverse types of exports (metals, processed goods), and thus reframe the concept as promoting an agreement on freedom of navigation in the Black Sea. HD remained part of the UN's mediation group and circulated these ideas within it, and also to the parties to the conflict at the highest levels to both parties plus Turkiye.

target.value: Participants have worked to define a common understanding of the threats in the Black Sea region, and their dialogue process has drawn on lessons learned from other shared waterways (eg Scandinavia, South China Sea).

actual.value: In the Black Sea track, HD continued to help the UN to implement the Russia-Ukraine grain deal at the JCC in Istanbul.

title.narrative: Joint preventive measures and end environmental projects are devised by experts in the Joint Ecological Dialogue Initiative, or JEDI format that contribute to averting a disaster near the frontline.
The Joint Ecological Dialogue initiative (JEDI) meets regular and develops proposals on how to address ecological problems in the region.

target.value: 3-4 options developed. The JEDI group has established cooperative mechanisms to mitigate ecological risks and prevent an ecological disaster. These are taken up by decision-makers and in official negotiations.

actual.value: At least 3 drafts of technical documents shared and discussed with parties of the conflict at high level. Direct input received, showing clear interest of decision-makers.

target.value: Participants have agreed and implemented informal mechanisms for dealing with emerging ecological problems.

actual.value: Joint preventive measures and environmental projects are devised by experts in the Joint Ecological Dialogue Initiative, or JEDI format that contribute to averting a disaster near the frontline

title.narrative: Trust between authorities and people divided by the contact line and around the Black Sea strengthened through dialogue and discreet joint work that addresses common challenges on both sides thereby complementing and enhancing the Track 1 peace process.

Engagement on issues of common concern, such as the environment, inclusion and socio-economic problems in the conflict zone and around the Black Sea, has resulted in joint approaches and initiatives to address these concerns.

target.value: The Black Sea and cross contact line dialogue activities have delivered win-wins to defuse tensions and improve people-to-people links, leading to a discreet and sustained engagement on the issues of common concern, as well as improved coexistence and mutual confidence.

actual.value: Despite circumstances, the Black Sea Grain Initiative is a clear example of a reduction in tensions (in terms of improved food security, both in Ukraine and worldwide). HD has fostered discreet and sustained engagement between the parties to the conflict and Turkiye on issues of common concern.

title.narrative: Policy options ideas developed by the Black Sea dialogue group that contribute to making behavior in the maritime zone more predictable, with a view of avoiding a miscalculation or re-escalation.

A group of political and maritime experts engages regularly in a substantial discussion about joint problems and opportunities for trilateral collaboration in the Black Sea, and develops concrete proposals for improved cooperation.

target.value: The experts have identified mutually agreed options for managing tensions in the Black Sea and promote these ideas among decision-makers in their respective capitals.

actual.value: Following the end of the Black Sea Grain Initiative, HD came up with and proposed several options for managing tensions in the Black Sea, including a proposal for freedom of navigation which was discussed with decision-makers.

target.value: Participants in the expert dialogue have defined common interests and threats, solidified a regular dialogue process and developed scenarios and/or roadmaps for finding common solutions.

actual.value: Participants in our ecological group worked together to come up with potential solutions to the problems of disused mines, critical infrastructure protection and nuclear safety.
